note: Curated exceptions for tools/bple-variants/import-variants.mjs. `variants` keys are BPLE prefab names inside GameData.m_customParts; absent prefabs are pure skins that copy their PigForge base entry. `extras` are IN extension variants the original adds outside the registry. `defer` keeps a prefab in the texture map but out of content. See docs/specs/part-variant-catalog.md.

Part_Sandbag_05_SET.note: Original sibling mass 1.1, this one 5 (same script/fields); scale the PigForge base mass by 5/1.1.

Part_SmallWheel_08_SET.note: Original prefab runs MotorWheel (force 50, power 100); siblings run CartWheel. Motor value matches PigForge motor-wheel.

Part_MetalFrame_11_SET.note: Original prefab carries an always-on PointLightSource size 5; PigForge flashlight size 7 -> light 3.0, so 3 * 5/7 = 2.14.

Part_Bellows_07_SET.note: Original m_alienBellow=1, m_boostForce=120 vs 30 for siblings; PigForge bellows 8.0 * (120/30) = 32.0.

Part_Kicker_4.note: Original customPartIndex 3 is the marker separator: not triggerable (PartExtensions.IsMarker). Inert box, no detacher capability.

Part_TNT_06_SET.note: AlienTNT: collisions never light it (AlienTNT.cs:48-50), only its switch does; chaining stays on like every charge. Radius/impulse are identical to the base charge in the original data.

Part_Egg_06_SET.note: AlienEgg: alien super glue (AlienEgg.cs:12-19,49-66) makes the frames in its connected component unbreakable; PigForge models that as glue (the compound never seam-splits).

extras.name: tnt-blaster
extras.note: BlasterTNT is an IN extension part (not in GameData.m_customParts). Original: mass 2 vs 1, armed by its switch, one-shot 2 s expanding shockwave (BlasterTNT.cs:123-157, 159-212), chain radius 8 (dist^2 < 64). PigForge approximates the wave with one radial impulse; radius/impulse are calibrated to the original near-field envelope (~36 impulse at 1 unit).
